objectives:
“提供基本的普通生物學, 生物化學, 與微生物學之知識
以利學生了解生化工程之應用與涵蓋範圍“
content:
1.Introduction of Biochemical Engineering (2hr)
2.Basics of Biology (3hr)
3.Enzymes (6hr)
4.Basics of Microorganisms (6hr)
5.Major Metabolic Pathways (6hr)
6.Cell Growth Kinetics (6hr)
7.Reactor Design (6hr)
8.Scale Up (6hr)
9.Mixed Culture (6hr)
books: “1.Bioprocess Engineering, Basic concepts, 2nd edition, edited by M.L. Shuler and F. Kargi, Prentice Hall, New Jersey, 2002.“
